strategies.description: Player points prop over — target players with minutes floor above bookmaker-implied minutes; edge from minutes deviation.
strategies.validation_gate: Projected minutes > line-implied minutes by ≥ 5 min; usage rate ≥ league avg for position

strategies.description: Same-game parlay: team moneyline + star player points over + game total over. Positive correlation: high-scoring star performance lifts team win probability and total.
strategies.correlation: Positive correlation between star points and team win; r ≈ 0.65 (estimated)
strategies.validation_gate: All three legs share same game script thesis; no contradictory legs

strategies.description: Same-game parlay: favorite spread + under on game total + under on starters' 4th-quarter props. Projected blowout → starters sit early → lower total.
strategies.correlation: Negative correlation between blowout margin and total points; starters' minutes reduced in blowouts
strategies.validation_gate: Projected spread ≥ 12 points; total line ≥ 5 pts above projected blowout total

strategies.description: Player rebounds over — target players vs. teams with high opponent rebound rate allowed at their position (Defense vs. Position).
strategies.validation_gate: Opponent allows ≥ league average + 3% rebound rate to player's position

strategies.description: Player assists over — high-usage point guard vs. team with high opponent assists allowed per game; pace-adjusted.
strategies.validation_gate: Pace ≥ 96 possessions; player usage% ≥ 25%; opponent DvP assists allowed ≥ league avg + 4%

strategies.description: Multi-game player prop parlay across 2–3 games, one prop per team per game, no correlated legs within same team.
strategies.correlation: Zero intra-team correlation by design; inter-game independence assumed
strategies.validation_gate: Max 1 prop per team per game; no two props from same team; max 4 legs

strategies.description: Game total under — back-to-back road game for high-pace offense; fatigue reduces shooting efficiency and pace.
strategies.correlation: Back-to-back fatigue reduces pace by ~1.5 possessions (estimated)
strategies.validation_gate: Team playing 2nd game of back-to-back on road; opponent resting ≥ 2 days

strategies.description: Same-game parlay: under on both teams' primary scorer props + under on game total. Projected defensive grind → low usage for both stars.
strategies.correlation: Negative correlation between defensive game script and star scoring; r ≈ -0.48 (estimated)
strategies.validation_gate: Both teams ranked top-10 in defensive rating; projected pace ≤ 92; total line ≥ 6 pts above projected
